mode: Independent injected native adapter and real fixed proof controller; subprocess and networking blocked

checks.name: Stopped Chrome is fenced before either generated cleanup script invokes the application
Only exact positive saved IDs are accepted; absence query reads no URLs/content/other targets and changes nothing
Unbound close is rejected before any native command or query
Confirmed close returns direct provenance, skips existence read and serves detached cached receipts
Failed and unconfirmed command output reconcile through exactly one original-window absence read without a cause claim
A tab missing from a present original window remains uncertain, preserving moved-tab boundary and one-attempt limit
Present target, failed query and malformed query output retain uncertainty without logging details or permitting reread
Concurrent direct bridge calls cannot repeat an ambiguous close or absence query
Receipt schema rejects foreign identities, contradictory outcomes, private additions and unsupported global destruction
Real guard reserves before a single native effect and records scoped evidence distinctly from command confirmation
Guard retains safe uncertain receipt and never resubmits after original window remains present
Foreign or malformed guard receipt consumes close authority without accepting cleanup
Concurrent guard close admissions execute only one command/query pair
Pre-effect durable reservation failure causes zero effects and cannot refill authority
Lost final journal acknowledgement blocks all replay rather than repeating a known observed close
